### Added

- (agent-platform) [Pick the namespace's EgressPolicies in the agent wizard](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3232) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — More options in the new agent wizard and in Edit lists the namespace's `EgressPolicies` to pick, each with its origins, above `Extra egress origins`; picks show on the review and the agent's page. Not offered for coding Harnesses. Needs agent-manager 2.12.0 or later.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.20.1...v3.21.0
